name: Disable TOTP
summary: The user confirms TOTP disable; the server removes authenticator and recovery-code material and clears MFA state for the current durable identity.

preconditions.expression: user is authenticated, TOTP is enabled, and disable has been explicitly confirmed

serverInteraction.intent: Disable TOTP exactly once, remove authenticator and recovery-code secrets, and clear TOTP replay/last-MFA state.

postconditions.expression: TOTP is disabled and the current durable identity remains signed in

sourceReferences.note: DisableMfaAsync is the single server operation and removes authenticator and recovery-code secrets before clearing TwoFactorEnabled and replay state.
